articles.summary: We rebuilt Richelle et al.'s 2022 CHO cell-culture intensification model in Invert Assist, turning a published paper into an executable, interactive report. The central question: could parameters fit on small-scale fed-batch data reproduce the paper's perfusion design without re-estimating the model? They could — and the reproduction surfaced a units mismatch, showed the bleed controller absorbs most parameter uncertainty, and pinpointed direct lysed-cell measurement as the highest-value next experiment.
articles.title: Reproducing a Published CHO Perfusion Model in Invert Assist
